fields.description: Gardenia Bay is Aldar’s canal-side residential community on Yas Island, opposite Yas Park. Its original apartment collection ranges from studios to three-bedroom homes, with shaded outdoor spaces and a waterfront promenade connecting daily life to the landscape.

sources.label: Aldar Gardenia Bay brochure, Almira-hosted copy
Aldar: Gardenia Jasmine building 14 apartment reference

reviewCoverage.identity: Aldar project and original launch reviewed; later releases are not treated as the same delivery tranche.
reviewCoverage.location: Yas Island and position opposite Yas Park confirmed by Aldar’s launch release.
reviewCoverage.residences: Original studio to three-bedroom apartments verified; later townhouse/expanded collections need separate unit confirmation.
reviewCoverage.areas: Brochure pages 32–40 visually reviewed, including ten original layout area labels in square metres.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Named amenities checked against the official project page.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Original AED 805,000 starting price retained as historical launch information; portal headline and unit-type prices differ.
reviewCoverage.payment: Property Finder reports 5/45/50 for the original release; no universal current schedule established.
reviewCoverage.handover: Original Q2 2027 target checked against the launch release; later official unit references show 2028. Later FY2025 pipeline table visually reviewed and prioritised for headline.
reviewCoverage.documents: Official CDN brochure returned 503; an Aldar-branded 50-page broker-hosted copy was downloaded and visually inspected. Floor plans are inside this brochure.

overview: The official presentation places shared facilities along the waterfront, with spaces for exercise, work and recreation. Apartment outlooks and walking distances vary by building; select the release and orientation before comparing homes.
research.locationNote: Aldar locates the community opposite Yas Park, with connections toward Yas Mall, Ferrari World and SeaWorld. Check the selected building’s access rather than treating promotional travel times as a guaranteed commute.
research.priceNote: Aldar’s August 2023 launch began at AED 805,000 for studios and AED 3.1m for three-bedroom apartments. Property Finder currently mixes a higher headline asking reference with older unit-type prices. The displayed figure is historical, not a confirmed available offer.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder’s original-release schedule is 5% at launch, 45% during construction and 50% on handover. Obtain the chosen building’s actual dated contract and paid-to-date balance; later phases may use different terms.
research.handoverNote: Q2 2027 was the original first-phase estimate. Later Aldar unit references include Q3 2028 for Jasmine building 14. A single completion date should not be applied to every Gardenia Bay building. The later FY2025 pipeline gives 2028.

units.label: 2-bedroom · A Corner / A Middle / B Corner

facts.label: Launch scope
facts.value: The 2023 announcement described 2,434 homes across the community, with 210 in the first release. These are masterplan and launch counts, not remaining availability.

facts.label: Interior options
facts.value: The reviewed brochure presents light and dark palettes. Its original plans cover Rosa, Orchid, Ivy and Iris; later buildings require their own approved drawings.
